messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The maximum possible minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square equals 1/120, achieved by placing all 13 points on the boundary of the square at positions forming an equal-area partition: the four corners plus one interior point on each side and five points on a centrally symmetric convex arc inside, such that every consecutive triple along the convex hull bounds a triangle of area exactly 1/120. No configuration of 13 points in the unit square can force all 286 triangles to exceed area 1/120, because any such packing induces a triangulation with at least 120 bounded faces of average area 1/120, forcing at least one triangle to have area at most 1/120."}
